findings.cause: The prospective overlay loaded its base runner with runpy. The base spawned-process verifier therefore retained the synthetic module name <run_path>, which Python multiprocessing cannot import while unpickling its submitted callable.
findings.why_focused_unit_tests_did_not_hide_scie: The defect occurred before candidate execution and before any scratch or atomic result; no scientific observation exists to reuse or rescore.
findings.why_source_finding_science_is_unchanged: The repair changes only how the validation wrapper imports its already-proven base runner. Candidate algorithms, configuration, data, seeds, metrics, margins, and comparator gates are unchanged.
